sections.title: Ingame Appearance
sections.content: Nyami's first and only thematic appearance is in Grand Quest, Eneroth: Genesis

sections.title: Background
sections.content:
An enigmatic Morokai thief from the land of Baldemar. While rummaging through a large slaver encampment, Nyami came across a cave packed with cages. Locked within them were hundreds of young children, their fates grim. The sight of the frightened children reminded of her bitter past, and how she was powerless to save her sister.

Refusing to allow history to repeat itself, Nyami discarded her loot, and proceeded to free the children. Instructing them to remain hidden and flee only after the slavers were distracted, she began her rampage around the slaver camp. Wherever she went, Nyami left a trail of destruction in her wake. Tents were set on fire, supplies were ruined and the livestock set loose. Fearing that her own escape could possibly turn the attention of the slavers towards the fleeing younglings, she held back her tears and fears and turned to face the enemy.

It was as if fate was on her side that day. Loud battle cries rang out from behind the enemy ranks. From within the new chaos emerged a hooded man with beautiful multicolored wings, riding upon a muddy sand hippo. He reached out his hand and told her, that the children she saved were waiting for their big sister to return home. Not too far away, the victorious cries chanting "Rih'alnase" rang out loud and clear.

sections.title: History
sections.content: Nyami spends the majority of her time complaining about how Ezra stole her pudding. It is implied that this is the only reason that Nyami joins the quest to find Ezra. Nyami goes with Allanon to defeat The High Inquisitor, Aranvis. After his defeat, Nyami and Allanon meet back with Summoner, where they find that Ezra has been subdued, and has returned to her original form.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: She is shown to have a shy yet happy personality. Repeatedly, throughout the Grand Quest, she is shown to have a huge craving for pudding.

sections.title: Ezra
sections.content: Nyami considers Ezra to be her sister

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Nyami is 16 years old.
- Despite Nyala being Nyami's older sister, Nyala has yet to appear in the story.
- Nyami's name could come from a solfège, which is a music education method used to teach pitch and sight singing Western music. "Nya" means "Meow" in Japanese. "mi" comes from the third note of "do re mi fa so la ti".
- Interestingly, Nyala follows this trend since the last syllable of her name "la" comes from the sixth note of the song. It could have some relation to Nyala being older since the note from "la" is higher-pitched than "mi".

- Nyami’s sphere, Nyami’s Bells, are a reference to the final gift given to Nyami by Nyala.

'''Nyami''' is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is a '''Morokai''' thief.

==Ingame Appearance==
Nyami's first and only thematic appearance is in Grand Quest, Eneroth: Genesis

==Background==
An enigmatic Morokai thief from the land of Baldemar. While rummaging through a large slaver encampment, Nyami came across a cave packed with cages. Locked within them were hundreds of young children, their fates grim. The sight of the frightened children reminded of her bitter past, and how she was powerless to save her sister.

Refusing to allow history to repeat itself, Nyami discarded her loot, and proceeded to free the children. Instructing them to remain hidden and flee only after the slavers were distracted, she began her rampage around the slaver camp. Wherever she went, Nyami left a trail of destruction in her wake. Tents were set on fire, supplies were ruined and the livestock set loose. Fearing that her own escape could possibly turn the attention of the slavers towards the fleeing younglings, she held back her tears and fears and turned to face the enemy.

It was as if fate was on her side that day. Loud battle cries rang out from behind the enemy ranks. From within the new chaos emerged a hooded man with beautiful multicolored wings, riding upon a muddy sand hippo. He reached out his hand and told her, that the children she saved were waiting for their big sister to return home. Not too far away, the victorious cries chanting "Rih'alnase" rang out loud and clear.

== History ==
Nyami spends the majority of her time complaining about how Ezra stole her pudding. It is implied that this is the only reason that Nyami joins the quest to find Ezra. Nyami goes with Allanon to defeat The High Inquisitor, Aranvis. After his defeat, Nyami and Allanon meet back with Summoner, where they find that Ezra has been subdued, and has returned to her original form.

==Personality==
She is shown to have a shy yet happy personality. Repeatedly, throughout the [[GQ:Eneroth|Grand Quest]], she is shown to have a huge craving for pudding.

**Interestingly, Nyala follows this trend since the last syllable of her name "la" comes from the sixth note of the song. It could have some relation to Nyala being older since the note from "la" is higher-pitched than "mi".

* Nyami’s sphere, Nyami’s Bells, are a reference to the final gift given to Nyami by Nyala.
